payload.summary: Therapy showed a false Source 100% meter on all 205 records; the field has no calculation anywhere
payload.detail: APPLIED 2026-09-16 (commit 37d6eddf6). Every Therapy record stored sourceCompleteness 100 and the review queue rendered it as a Source 100% meter (src/components/therapy-compass/screens/other-screen.tsx). A repository-wide search found the field only in the type declaration and in that meter, so the value had no computational basis, and for the 47 records that carry no references and whose only source object has a null reference it was demonstrably false. All 205 cite a single Notion export filename as their only source. Set to null on all 205; the Meter primitive renders null as 'Unknown', which its own comment describes as the intended state, and four existing test fixtures already used null here. Regenerating the catalogue rotated the content-addressed asset, which also required updating site-content-change-owners.json and the static site-content manifest baseline. Verified: npm run test (1373 files, 20800 tests), build-therapies-index --check, build-site-content-manifest --check with changedCount 0. REMAINING WORK: none for this row, but sourceCompleteness now reads Unknown everywhere and stays that way until someone defines and implements a real calculation. Close on reconciliation.
